subject: infoschema: add WithRefillOption for TableByName and TableByID (#55511)
summary: Adds `infoschema.WithRefillOption(ctx, bool)` to control infoschema v2 table-cache refill for `TableByName` (default refill) and `TableByID` (default no-refill), updates a few callers to disable refill in bulk/diagnostic lookups, and changes `loadTableInfo` to return errors instead of panicking on meta read errors. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in DDL/infoschema correctness, metadata consistency, or concurrency for this change.
